info.title: egami-video
info.description: The egami-video command: inspect, remux, cut, join, export frames, make clips and convert audio from a shell with Egami.Video, a fully managed video library. ffprobe- and ffmpeg-style jobs without native code.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Look for black, frozen, silent, cropped, interlaced and duplicate stretches, scene cuts, signal levels and loudness in one pass, as ffmpeg's detection filters do.

options.name: --track
options.description: Which tracks: v, a, s or d with an optional :index or :language (a:1, s:eng), or a track number as info shows it. Repeat it or separate with commas; all tracks by default.

options.name: --no-audio
options.description: Leave out audio tracks.

options.name: --no-subtitles
options.description: Leave out subtitle tracks.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Take every media file in folders given as inputs, at any depth.

options.name: --jobs
options.description: How many files to work on at once; 0 (the default) for one per processor.

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: Stop at the first file that fails.

options.name: --detect
options.description: What to look for, separated by commas or repeated: scenes, black, freeze, crop, interlace, duplicates, signal, blur, blockiness, silence, levels, loudness.

options.name: --all
options.description: Run every detector the file has a track for; blur and blockiness come with signal.

options.name: --start
options.description: Start here instead of at the beginning.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Look at this much and stop.

options.name: --series
options.description: Also write per-frame and per-100 ms values (scene scores, black share, signal levels, loudness) to this CSV file.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the findings as JSON.

options.name: --csv
options.description: Write the findings as CSV, one row per range or value.

options.name: --ffmpeg-log
options.description: Instead of the report, print the findings on standard error in the shape these ffmpeg filters log them, for scripts that read ffmpeg's output: blackdetect, freezedetect, cropdetect, idet, signalstats, blurdetect, blockdetect, silencedetect, volumedetect, astats, ebur128.

options.name: --scene-method
options.description: How scene changes are scored: adaptive (the default), content or histogram.

options.name: --scene-threshold
options.description: How sharp a change starts a scene, from 0 to 1. Default 0.15 for adaptive, 0.4 otherwise.

options.name: --scene-min
options.description: The shortest scene. Default 0.6s.

options.name: --black-min
options.description: The shortest black stretch reported, as blackdetect's d. Default 2s.

options.name: --black-ratio
options.description: The share of black pixels that makes a frame black, as blackdetect's pic_th. Default 0.98.

options.name: --black-pixel
options.description: How dark a pixel must be to count as black, as a share of the luma range, as blackdetect's pix_th. Default 0.10.

options.name: --freeze-min
options.description: The shortest frozen stretch reported, as freezedetect's d. Default 2s.

options.name: --freeze-noise
options.description: How much change still counts as frozen, as a ratio (0.001) or in dB (-60dB), as freezedetect's n. Default 0.001.

options.name: --silence-min
options.description: The shortest silence reported, as silencedetect's d. Default 2s.

options.name: --silence-noise
options.description: The level under which audio is silent, in dB (-50dB) or as a ratio (0.003), as silencedetect's n. Default -60dB.

options.name: --silence-per-channel
options.description: Also report each channel's silences, as silencedetect's mono.

options.name: --crop-limit
options.description: The brightest a border may be, as a share of the range (0.094) or an 8-bit value (24), as cropdetect's limit. Default 24.

options.name: --crop-round
options.description: Round the width and height down to a multiple of this, as cropdetect's round. Default 2.

options.name: --crop-skip
options.description: Frames at the start not measured, as cropdetect's skip. Default 2.

options.name: --dup-hi
options.description: The block difference no 8x8 block may pass, as mpdecimate's hi. Default 768.

options.name: --dup-lo
options.description: The block difference only --dup-frac of blocks may pass, as mpdecimate's lo. Default 320.

options.name: --dup-frac
options.description: The share of blocks that may pass --dup-lo, as mpdecimate's frac. Default 0.33.
